name: mappin
description: Mappin – plan trips day by day on a map. Website + iOS + Android (Capacitor).

scripts.android:init: npm run vendor && npx cap add android && npx capacitor-assets generate --android --assetPath assets && node scripts/patch-native.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios:init: npm run vendor && npx cap add ios && npx capacitor-assets generate --ios --assetPath assets && node scripts/patch-native.mjs && npx cap sync ios
scripts.sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync
